pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

6. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

10. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.

11. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

12. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   B. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Handball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — The speed of the music

3. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Red, blue, and yellow

8. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. C — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handball; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descant Recorder; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Storytelling and Animation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
